Jade_Karma.name: Karma
Jade_Karma.title: The Enlightened One
Jade_Karma.lore: - The abilities are completely different. Read the descriptions.
Jade_Karma.blurb: - The abilities are completely different. Read the descriptions.

spells.name: Heavenly Wave
spells.description:
Karma sends forth hidden blades from her fans, damaging enemies in a cone.

Mantra: Heavenly Wave also heals allies in the cone based on their missing Health.
spells.tooltip:
Karma sends forth hidden blades from her fans, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to enemies in a cone.

Mantra: Heavenly Wave also Heals allies in the cone for {{ basehealth }} plus {{ additionalhealpercent }} of their missing Health.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Spirit Bond
spells.description:
Karma creates a beam between her and another unit. Allied anchors move faster and enemy anchors are slowed. The beam damages enemies and applies the same movement speed adjustment to any champion it passes through.

Mantra: Karma strengthens the bond to increase the movement speed effect.
spells.tooltip:
Karma creates a beam between her and another unit for up to {{ duration }} seconds. Allied anchors, including herself, gain {{ movespeedmod*100 }}% move speed. Enemy anchors are Slowed by {{ movespeedmod*100 }}%.

The beam deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to all enemies it touches. Allied and enemy Champions receive the same movement speed adjustment as the anchors.

Mantra: Karma strengthens the bond, increasing the movement speed modifiers to {{ mantramovespeedmod }}.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Soul Shield
spells.description:
Karma summons a protective shield on an ally that absorbs incoming damage.

Mantra: In addition to casting the shield, energy radiates out from the shield, damaging enemies around her target.
spells.tooltip:
Karma summons a protective Shield that absorbs {{ totalshield }} damage for {{ duration }} seconds.

Mantra: Energy radiates out from the shield, dealing {{ totalshield }} magic damage to enemy units around her target.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Mantra
spells.description: Karma empowers her next ability to do an additional effect. Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point.
spells.tooltip:
Karma empowers her next ability with an additional effect. Karma gains a charge every {{ mantracooldown }} seconds up to 2 charges.

The refresh rate is reduced by Cooldown Reduction.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Inner Flame
passive.description: Karma gains Ability Power based on her missing Health.
